_meta.source: Google Sheets — Carla's legacy CRM (lead-tracking sheet shared 2026-06-26)
_meta.context: Each row in the source sheet was a real Meta Ads lead generated by the YBMT marketing team. Matt handles first-contact triage; the 'Notes from Corrina' column is the running outcome log (Corrina = PMO oversight). The latest note in each row represents the CURRENT real-world stage of that lead.

stage_mapping.1: RFQ Received — new lead, awaiting Matt's first action (or attempting contact, no engagement yet)
stage_mapping.2: Site Visit Scheduled — Matt has booked a site inspection
stage_mapping.3: Site Visit Complete — visit done, awaiting next action
stage_mapping.4: Quote In Preparation — actively building the quote
stage_mapping.5: Quote Sent — quote delivered to client
stage_mapping.11: Lost / Withdrawn — lead disqualified or chose not to proceed

reject_reason_mapping.3: Project cancelled / postponed by client (client said no, accidental click)
reject_reason_mapping.4: Scope changed (work outside YBMT scope, e.g. bath→shower swap)
reject_reason_mapping.6: No response from client (cold lead, no engagement after multiple attempts) — used sparingly, only when explicitly gone cold
reject_reason_mapping.7: Went with another contractor (found someone else)
reject_reason_mapping.9: Other (out-of-area, bad contact details, didn't fill in form, etc.)
